title: Open Incident Routing Context
description: Every incident currently open in this project, with its severity, status, affected services, current assignee and how long it has been running. Read-only. Vendor-agnostic - it reads the platform's own incident record, so it is the same evidence whether the alerts came from Datadog, CloudWatch or an Airflow DAG. Deliberately unwindowed: "what is open" is a question about now, and a lookback would hide the incident burning since Tuesday - the one routing most needs.
